data.exact_reserve_text: During the year there was a positive net run-off contribution of GBP 36,411,000 (2013 GBP 45,805,000), of which the main contributors were third party liability, GBP 9,020,000 and marine, aviation and transport GBP 3,590,000 (2013 marine, aviation and transport GBP 7,492,000 and other damage to property GBP 10,507,000). There was a positive development on reinsurance acceptances of GBP 26,795,000 (2013 GBP 25,109,000).
data.standardized_narrative: The Syndicate recorded prior-year favorable development in 2014, with an overall net run-off contribution reported of GBP 36.411m on direct business and a further positive development of GBP 26.795m on reinsurance acceptances (combined net release ~GBP 63.206m). The main direct-line contributors called out were third party liability and marine/aviation and transport. This movement is disclosed as favourable claims development rather than linked to any specific named catastrophe events.

data.data_quality_notes: Prior-year development figures in the notes are reported as 'net' run-off contributions. No explicit gross (insurance liabilities) prior-year movement table was found in the provided pages, so a net figure from the narrative has been used (net of reinsurance). The note separates a GBP 36.411m positive net run-off contribution (direct classes) and a GBP 26.795m positive development on reinsurance acceptances; these have been combined here as the syndicate-wide prior-year movement. Opening reserves were taken from the Balance Sheet 'Claims outstanding' prior-year column. No claims development triangle was included in the provided excerpt to compute gross PYD; mapping of 'Marine, aviation and transport' to a single standard LOB ('Marine') was necessary for LOB-level movement reporting and carries some uncertainty.
